name: In the Strait of Gibraltar
source: IMO COLREG.2/Circ.66, Annex 1: amendments to the existing traffic separation scheme "In the Strait of Gibraltar", adopted by the Maritime Safety Committee at its 94th session (17-21 November 2014), implemented at 0000 UTC on 1 June 2015. Reference chart 445 of the Hydrographic Institute of the Spanish Navy (IHM), 4th edition June 2007, datum WGS 84.
checkedBy: Unverified transcription: values moved unchanged from the points table of tools/build_chart.py on 2026-09-06 and read back against the text of COLREG.2/Circ.66 Annex 1. A navigator must still check every position against IHM chart 445 (or the current edition) and the circular in force before the chart is trusted at sea.
notes: Point ids are the position numbers of Annex 1. Positions are written as degrees and decimal minutes exactly as printed in the circular; the builder converts them with degrees + minutes / 60.

Points with role 'construction' are not in the circular: they carry an inshore-zone boundary inland (a meridian of an IMO point at a latitude well over the land) so that clipToLand can cut the zone at the OpenStreetMap coastline.
Order matters: the lists below are the order the polygons are written to chart-data.js and the order the app checks and draws them.

The eastern lane pair (points 1-2) runs 252/072 true; flowDeg keeps the cardinal 270/090 the app used before this file existed so the spoken crossing headings (180/000) do not change. Switch to 252/072 only after replaying the east route (node tools/replay.js) and reviewing the new crossing headings.

Anchorage Alpha (note 1 of the circular) is inside the south-western inshore traffic zone; ships bound for it enter that zone by its western limit from the Atlantic or by its eastern limit from Tanger-Med or the Mediterranean. Ships bound for or leaving Tanger-Med use the traffic lanes (rule 10).

crossing.text: Cross a traffic lane on a heading as nearly as practicable at right angles to the general direction of traffic flow: the app steers to flowDeg + 90 or flowDeg - 90, whichever is closer to the leg course, and does not slow down inside the lane.

points.note: Western limit of the northern inshore zone (meridian 5 44.98 W) carried north over the Spanish coast.
Eastern limit of the northern inshore zone (meridian 5 25.68 W) carried north over the Spanish coast.
Meridian of point 24 carried south over the Moroccan coast (boundary between the south-western inshore zone and the free navigation area).
Meridian of point 12 (5 44.98 W) carried south over the Moroccan coast (western limit of the south-western inshore zone).
Meridian of point 19 carried south over the Moroccan coast (eastern limit of the free navigation area).

separationZones.name: Separation zone (west)
separationZones.enter: In the separation zone. Keep crossing, do not linger.

separationZones.name: Separation zone (east)
separationZones.enter: In the separation zone. Keep crossing, do not linger.

lanes.name: Westbound lane (west)
lanes.enter: Entering the WESTBOUND traffic lane. Ships come from your LEFT, from the east. Keep crossing at right angles, do not slow down.

lanes.name: Eastbound lane (west)
lanes.enter: Entering the EASTBOUND traffic lane. Ships come from your RIGHT, from the west. Keep crossing at right angles.

lanes.name: Westbound lane (east)
lanes.enter: Entering the WESTBOUND traffic lane (east part). Ships come from the east. Cross at right angles.

lanes.name: Eastbound lane (east)
lanes.enter: Entering the EASTBOUND traffic lane (east part). Ships come from the west. Cross at right angles.

precautionary.name: Precautionary area (east, Gibraltar-Ceuta)
precautionary.enter: Entering the precautionary area. Ships converge from Algeciras, Gibraltar, Ceuta and Tanger-Med. Sharp lookout.

precautionary.name: Precautionary area Tanger-Med
precautionary.enter: Entering the Tanger-Med precautionary area. Ships turning into and out of the port.

inshoreZones.name: Northern inshore traffic zone (Spain)
inshoreZones.enter: In the Spanish inshore traffic zone. Stay north of the lanes.

inshoreZones.name: South-western inshore traffic zone (Morocco)
inshoreZones.enter: In the Moroccan inshore traffic zone. Follow the coast to Tangier.

freeAreas.name: Free navigation area off Tanger-Med (port approaches, ferries)
freeAreas.enter: Off Tanger-Med: ferries and container ships manoeuvring. Keep clear of the port approaches.

anchorages.name: Anchorage Alpha (Tanger-Med ships)
anchorages.note: Circle of 0.4 nm radius inside the south-western inshore traffic zone (circular note 1). The passage file alerts on it as hazard anch_alpha.
